name: Annecy Mont-Blanc

runway.v: Paved runway 04/22, 1,630 m × 30 m (plus a grass strip 04R/22L 845 m × 60 m)

hours.v: Aerodrome operator 08:00–19:00 local (0700-1800 UTC winter, 0600-1700 UTC summer). ATC 09:00–19:00 local (0800-1800 UTC winter); approach procedures not allowed outside ATS hours.

customs.v: International flights allowed 08:00–20:00 local (0700-1900 UTC winter, 0600-1800 UTC summer), on conditions, with 24 h prior permission from the aerodrome operator

ppr.v: Prior permission 24 hours ahead from the aerodrome operator for international flights
ppr.quote: 1 - PPR PN 24 HR from AD operator.

handling.v: Handling must be requested on the MyHandling portal for any aircraft of 3 t or more, and for any aircraft at weekends from 1 Dec to 1 Apr
handling.quote: any aircraft weighing more than 3t or more, for any aircraft over a WE from 1st of December till 1st of April.

fuel.v: Fuelling 08:00–19:00 local (0700-1800 UTC winter); 100LL and Jet A1

deicing.quote: 11 Dégivrage / De-icing Sur demande PN 45 minutes. On request PN 45 minutes.

notes: Read the SIA eAIP AD 2 LFLP PDF in the 29 Oct 2026 set (pages AIRAC AMDT 08/26, 06 Aug 2026). French AIP times are UTC in winter and one hour earlier in summer, so the local times above hold all year. No night ban is stated; the aerodrome is simply closed outside its hours. Short runway (1,630 m): heavy jets limited; commercial aircraft and those needing over 1,200 m take-off have special operating requirements and crew training (simulator or on-site for night/low ceiling). Winter weekend arrivals run under a COHOR facilitation scheme (AD 2.23, not quoted here, check before winter weekend trips).
